summary: Verastem, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 3 to its Note Purchase Agreement with Oberland Capital, restructuring existing senior secured notes and adding a new Revenue Notes series. The amendment replaces conditional tranches of $25M and $50M Initial Notes with a $50M Revenue Notes tranche due August 28, 2026, subject to conditions, and an optional $25M tranche exercisable by May 15, 2027, contingent on net sales of at least $40M for combined avutometinib/defactinib products in the prior quarter. Revenue Notes carry no fixed interest but require quarterly payments based on a percentage of product net sales. This financing amendment is a material agreement but not a conventional special situation; watch for liquidity and sales milestones.
